headline: Denied a variance for a house at 384 Butman Road; approved an addition at 65 Garden Road.
summary: Neighbors spoke against the Butman Road home over narrow streets, parking, and drainage. The vote on that home split three to three. The Chelmsford Street sign request was continued to January 11, 2027.
decisions: Denied a variance for a single-family home at 384 Butman Road. The motion failed on a three-to-three roll call.
Approved illuminated signs at 2 Prince Ave, with the large wall sign lit only until 8:00 p.m. and a plan showing the pylon signs will not block sight lines.
Approved a variance for an addition at 65 Garden Road, with a condition that the work add no runoff to neighboring properties.
Continued the illuminated sign request for 524 Chelmsford Street to January 11, 2027.
discussion: 384 Butman Road home: Speakers said the narrow street cannot hold extra parked cars and that drainage would get worse. The applicant said the hardship came from a permit error, not from its own actions.
Markley signs at 2 Prince Ave: A speaker objected to the company and asked for a denial. Members questioned whether the signs needed to be lit around the clock.

Garden Road addition drainage: Neighbors reported basement flooding and worried that new paving would send runoff onto their lots. The applicant agreed to a condition that the work add no runoff to neighboring properties.
Practical difficulty standard: Members discussed how to apply the state's new variance test to undersized lots, weighing lot size against neighborhood character.
